disclaimer.heading: Disclaimer
disclaimer.intro: Please read this disclaimer carefully before using Property.com.ve.
disclaimer.notRealEstateAgencyContent: Property.com.ve is a property listing aggregator, not a real estate agency. We do not buy, sell, rent, or manage properties. We simply aggregate listings from third-party sources to help users search for properties in Venezuela.
disclaimer.thirdPartyListingsContent: All property listings displayed on this website are sourced from third-party real estate platforms. We do not create, verify, or endorse any of the listings. The information displayed is provided by the original listing sources.
disclaimer.accuracyOfInformationContent: While we strive to display accurate and up-to-date information, we cannot guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or reliability of any listing information. Property details, prices, availability, and other information may change without notice. Always verify information directly with the listing agent or property owner.
disclaimer.investmentRisksContent: Real estate investment carries inherent risks. Property values may fluctuate, and past performance is not indicative of future results. We strongly recommend consulting with qualified professionals, including real estate agents, lawyers, and financial advisors, before making any property investment decisions.
disclaimer.noProfessionalAdviceContent: Nothing on this website constitutes legal, financial, or investment advice. Any decisions made based on information found on this website are made at your own risk.
disclaimer.externalLinksContent: Our website contains links to external websites operated by third parties. We have no control over the content or availability of these websites and accept no responsibility for them.
disclaimer.contactOriginalListingContent: For accurate, current information about any property, please contact the original listing agent or property owner directly through the source website. Links to the original listings are provided on each property detail page.
disclaimer.takedownRequestsContent: If you are the owner of a listing and wish to have it removed from our platform, please submit a takedown request. We will process your request within 48 hours.
disclaimer.changesContent: We reserve the right to modify this disclaimer at any time. Changes will be effective immediately upon posting to this website.
disclaimer.contactUsContent: If you have any questions about this disclaimer, please contact us through our website.
disclaimer.privacyPolicyRedirect: For information about how we collect, use, and protect your data, including data obtained through Google services, please see our dedicated privacy policy.

privacyPolicy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how Property.com.ve collects, uses, stores, and protects your data, including data obtained through Google services. By using our platform, you consent to the practices described in this policy.
privacyPolicy.googleApiCompliance: Google API Services User Data Policy Compliance
privacyPolicy.googleApiComplianceContent: Property.com.ve's use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
privacyPolicy.googleApiPolicyLinkText: Google API Services User Data Policy
privacyPolicy.limitedUseContent: Property.com.ve's use of information received from Google APIs adheres to the following restrictions:
privacyPolicy.limitedUseItem1: We only use Google user data for the purposes described in this privacy policy — specifically, account creation and authentication on the Property.com.ve platform.
privacyPolicy.limitedUseItem2: We do not use Google user data for serving advertisements.
privacyPolicy.limitedUseItem3: We do not allow humans to read your Google user data unless: (a) we have your affirmative consent, (b) it is necessary for security purposes such as investigating abuse, (c) it is necessary to comply with applicable law, or (d) our use is limited to internal operations and the data has been aggregated and anonymized.
privacyPolicy.limitedUseItem4: We do not transfer Google user data to third parties except as necessary to provide or improve the platform's functionality, as required by law, or in connection with a merger or acquisition with adequate data protection.
privacyPolicy.scopesRequestedContent: When you sign in with Google, Property.com.ve requests the following OAuth scopes:
privacyPolicy.scopeEmail: email — to retrieve your email address for account creation
privacyPolicy.scopeProfile: profile — to retrieve your name and profile picture for account personalization
privacyPolicy.dataAccessedContent: When you sign in using Google, Property.com.ve accesses the following Google user data: your name, email address, and profile picture. This information is provided by Google's OAuth 2.0 authentication service with your explicit consent. We also use Google Analytics to collect anonymized usage data such as pages visited, session duration, and general geographic region.
privacyPolicy.dataUsageContent: Your Google account data is used solely to create and maintain your Property.com.ve account, enabling features such as saved property searches, search alerts, and personalized recommendations. Your email address may be used to send transactional notifications related to your account activity. Google Analytics data is used in aggregate to understand site usage patterns and improve our service. We do not use your Google data for advertising, profiling, or any purpose unrelated to the Property.com.ve platform.
privacyPolicy.dataSharingContent: Property.com.ve does not sell, rent, or share your Google user data with any third parties for marketing or advertising purposes. Your data may be shared only with the following service providers, strictly for operating the platform: Supabase (database hosting and authentication), Vercel (website hosting), and Google Analytics (anonymized usage analytics). These providers process data under their own privacy policies and data processing agreements. No Google user data is shared with real estate agents, advertisers, or any other external parties.
privacyPolicy.dataStorageContent: Your data is stored securely in Supabase (PostgreSQL) with Row Level Security (RLS) policies that restrict data access. All data transmission is encrypted via HTTPS/TLS. Authentication tokens are managed securely through Supabase's authentication infrastructure. We implement industry-standard security measures to protect against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction of your personal data.
privacyPolicy.dataRetentionContent: Your account data is retained for as long as your account remains active. You may request deletion of your account and all associated data at any time by contacting us at support@property.com.ve. Upon receiving a deletion request, we will permanently remove your personal data within 30 days. You may also revoke Property.com.ve's access to your Google account at any time through your Google Account permissions page (myaccount.google.com/permissions).
privacyPolicy.contactUsContent: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or our data practices, please contact us at support@property.com.ve.

takedown.heading: Takedown Request
takedown.description: If you are the owner of a listing and wish to have it removed from our platform, please submit a request below.
takedown.beforeItem1: We aggregate listings from third-party sources. We do not create listings.
takedown.beforeItem2: To permanently remove a listing, contact the original source directly.
takedown.beforeItem3: Listings may reappear if they remain active on the source website.
takedown.notice: We aim to process all takedown requests within 48 hours. You will receive a confirmation email once your request has been processed.
